title: 16.41. Uppannattika, Hetuduka
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Uppanno hetu dhammo naanupannassa nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Uppanno hetu dhammo nauppādissa nahetussa dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. Uppanno hetu dhammo naanuppannassa nahetussa ca nauppādissa nahetussa ca dhammassa hetupaccayena paccayo. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi, ārammaṇe nava, adhipatiyā tīṇi …pe… sahajāte tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
